# Prepaid pipeline admission qualification

Video sources/decoders and Metal preparations now use a sub-ledger backed by
the shared model execution permit. MJPEG retains the output charge after decode;
Metal release fences command completion and keeps the output charge until
destruction. Five preparation slots, coefficient storage and native decoder
surfaces are accounted in the parent reservation. These conservative bounds
require later measured tuning; no throughput improvement is claimed.

The production CPU/Metal server passes six original mixed/video cases, 128
dimensions, forced admission denial/retry and damaged-frame cleanup/retry. Its
eight WebM vectors preserve all three rankings and top-k sets; concurrent,
sustained and disconnect/retry checks pass. Disconnect/retry does not prove
cancellation completion. Seventeen model units pass; 156 macOS video tests pass
with two platform skips. Actual Linux ARM64 runs 134 with 24 platform skips.

Source, production/library binary and report hashes identify the qualified
implementation. Earlier pretrained receipts retain their original source scope.
HTTP preflight admission, cross-request stage overlap, current Linux pretrained
execution and the other non-CUDA goal items remain active. Shared-host timing
records are correctness/ownership evidence, not isolated capacity benchmarks.
